rationale: On the source probability-space domain, the local definitions compose to exactly ‖X‖_{ψ₂}=inf{t>0:E exp(X²/t²)≤2}: the ENNReal representation excludes zero and infinity as candidates, explicit integrability correctly protects the real Bochner integral, the threshold is exactly 2, and no centering condition is introduced. Because this broader domain has satisfiable non-probability instances, Lean implies the source specialization while the source does not entail the full generalized Lean proposition; the result is therefore faithful-stronger.
